description: Inferred boarding edge for stop_times at tier-bern stops that reference only the station. One record per (stop_id, route, direction_id, headsign, next stop). status = resolved (edge_sloid set) or unresolved (unresolved_reason set). This table is an addition: timetable.json, the GTFS subset and gtfs_stop_map are unchanged and stay the source of truth.
inferred_how: bearing-vs-compass: atlas compass_direction_deg of each boarding edge of the stop compared with the bearing from that edge to the next stop of the trip; accepted when the best difference is <= 50 degrees and the second-best edge is >= 60 degrees worse

method.rule: bearing-vs-compass: atlas compass_direction_deg of each boarding edge of the stop compared with the bearing from that edge to the next stop of the trip; accepted when the best difference is <= 50 degrees and the second-best edge is >= 60 degrees worse

thresholds.confidence_high: best <= 25 deg, margin >= 120 deg, exactly two candidate edges, no edge of the stop without compass or coordinate

method.candidates: atlas BOARDING_PLATFORM edges of the stop's station that are valid during the feed and have a coordinate and compass_direction_deg
method.bearing: initial great-circle bearing from the candidate edge to the next stop coordinate of the trip (straight line, not track or road)

unresolved_reasons.no_edge_at_stop: atlas holds no boarding edge for the stop (the Matte lift stations, Bern Europaplatz whose edges atlas files under another service point)
unresolved_reasons.one_edge_only: atlas holds a single edge; it is not assumed to be the one
unresolved_reasons.edges_without_compass_or_coordinates: fewer than two edges have both a coordinate and a compass direction
unresolved_reasons.ambiguous: best edge further than the threshold from the travel bearing, or the second-best too close
unresolved_reasons.last_stop_of_trip: no next stop, so no travel bearing

sources.origin: opentransportdata.swiss Timetable 2026 (GTFS2020), valid 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12, file gtfs_fp2026_20261118.zip

back_test.what: the same rule applied to stop_times at tier-bern stops where GTFS names the edge; the named edge is the truth
